description: Planning input for every API consumer: one entry per rate limit with the limit itself, how it was learned, how to read live headroom, and who spends it. Metadata only. Consumers declare their expected calls/hour in the file that makes the calls with a line `api-budget: <limit-id> <N>/hr - <reason>`; scripts/rate-limit-headroom.mjs sums those against the limit and overlays live reads. Contract: .claude/rules/external-apis.md.

limits.label: GitHub REST, personal gh login (Tim's token; Mac agents, Hermes scripts)
limits.scope: per user token, shared by every process using it
limits.source: x-ratelimit-limit header on the rate_limit resource, 2026-10-28
consumers: scripts/lanes via apiclient when GH_TOKEN is the user token
limits.notes: 2026-10-28 16:40Z sample: 962 used in the first 40 minutes of the window by one fleet. Prefer the App token for fleet work.

limits.label: GitHub GraphQL, personal gh login
consumers: gh pr/issue list and view (all are GraphQL)
limits.notes: Cost is points, not calls: one aliased batch() query is far cheaper than N gh pr view calls.

limits.label: GitHub search API
limits.notes: Separate bucket; `gh pr list --search` overlap checks burn it first. Use list + filter locally when polling.

limits.label: GitHub REST, App installation tokens (jovie-bot for Gem lanes; jovie-ci-lane, jovie-symphony-lane, jovie-agents-lane, jovie-docs-lane)
limits.scope: per installation, independent of the user token
limits.source: rate_limit with a minted jovie-bot token, 2026-10-28; GitHub scales installations on large orgs up to 12,500
consumers: CI App token reads in workflows
limits.notes: Own bucket per installation; the cheapest place to move read-only fleet traffic.

limits.label: GitHub GraphQL, App installation token (jovie-bot)
limits.source: rate_limit with a minted jovie-bot token, 2026-10-28
limits.notes: 1972 of 5000 points used when sampled mid-window.

limits.label: GITHUB_TOKEN inside Actions (per repo, shared by all workflows)
limits.scope: per repo, shared by every workflow run
limits.source: GitHub docs for the Team plan: 1,000/hr/repo. The 05:22Z 2026-10-25 api-quota sample showed limit=5000; plan against 1,000 until that is stable.
consumers: Merge Queue Green Enroll (samples quota about once a minute)
PR Fleet Rules / PR Ready evidence reads
limits.notes: 2026-10-25 demand was 5-7x the limit; Fleet Rules Evidence and PR Ready deferred every hour. Declared per workflow with `# github-token-budget: N calls/run` (workflow-token-budget-guard).

limits.label: GitHub secondary limits (all tokens)
limits.scope: REST 900 points/min per token; 100 concurrent requests; 80 content-creating requests/min, 500/hr
limits.source: docs.github.com rate limits for the REST API
limits.notes: The client's minWriteIntervalMs (1s) and pacing exist for this; a 403/429 with 'secondary rate limit' opens the breaker.

limits.label: Linear API requests
limits.source: x-ratelimit-requests-limit in the host ledger (last observed 2026-10-21)
consumers: lanes linear_sync / remediation intake (Jovie Lanes Linear app)
limits.notes: App tokens and personal keys are separate buckets; never use a personal key for fleet work (#22378).

limits.label: Linear query complexity
limits.notes: Wide nested queries cost far more than their count; a single query is capped at 10,000.

limits.label: Vercel REST API
limits.source: Limits are per endpoint and arrive in x-ratelimit-* headers; the ledger has not recorded any yet
limits.notes: Gap: route Vercel calls through the client so the ledger learns the limit.

limits.label: Sentry API
limits.source: host ledger, last observed 2026-10-22; window is not stated by the header
limits.notes: Treat as a burst limit: serialize Sentry calls; do not fan out.

limits.label: Vercel AI Gateway
limits.scope: shared prepaid credit across every Gateway key and project (ops/registry/spend.json: vercel-ai-gateway-credits)
limits.source: ops/registry/spend.json; the binding limit is dollars, not request rate
limits.notes: Check runway with scripts/credentials-spend-check.mjs; a priced call passes priceUsd.

limits.label: Cloudflare API
limits.notes: Equals 14,400/hr if spread evenly; a 429 blocks the token for the rest of the 5-minute window.

limits.label: Neon control-plane API
consumers: branch create/delete in CI and agent worktrees
limits.notes: Not in packages/api-client/providers.json yet (no registered host); branch fan-out is the only realistic way to hit it.

limits.label: gbrain MCP daemon (127.0.0.1:7801) over Supabase pooler
limits.scope: one shared daemon, one Postgres pool, one local ollama
limits.source: scripts/agent/gbrain-latency-bench.py; see the latency table in .claude/rules/gstack.md
limits.notes: No rate limit, a latency budget: default `query` pays a ~6s local llama3.2 expansion; agents use expand=false. Load average above 20 on the Mac multiplies every arm by 3-4x.

limits.label: Hyperagent API / MCP
limits.notes: Gap: spend and rate unknown; the research router enforces per-source daily caps.

limits.label: Direct model providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI)
limits.notes: Plan quota, not request rate; route by pace policy in capacity.json.
